bonuses.name: Living Metal
bonuses.text: At the start of each of this Threat’s turns it regains 1 Wound and 1 Shock.

bonuses.name: Inescapable Death
bonuses.text: This Threat ignores all environmental DN penalties (cover, lighting conditions, etc.) to Ballistic Skill Tests.

bonuses.name: Multi-threat Eliminator
bonuses.text: When using its Enmitic Disintegrator Pistols, this Threat can Multi-Attack 6 times without suffering a DN penalty.

abilities.name: Dimensional Translocation
abilities.text: The Hexmark Destroyer emerges from a hidden dimensional oubliette, automatically Ambushing all Agents. They cannot emerge closer than 10m.

abilities.name: Hardwired for Destruction
abilities.text: When you spend Ruin to re-roll all failing dice for a Hexmark Destroyer’s Ballistic Skill Test, results of 3 and 4 count as Icons and results of 5 and 6 count as Exalted Icons.
